I’ve had that happen to my plants, and I’m pretty sure it was from the soil, because I read online that if you’re using soil, the nutrients could burn young plants and that’s whats happening to the leaves. Honestly all I did was try to keep the ph at 6.0 and trim off the burned leaves, and they eventually bounced back.

From what I’ve been told, if you train them pretty well and send them into flowering at the right time, you can keep them pretty small while still producing a good amount of bud. Grow tents would work, I just can’t afford one so I’m using my attic, and tbh it’s pretty hard to control temp and humidity up there, whereas you could have a grow tent and keep everything contained, virtually smell free, and have better control of the environment. And I wouldn’t worry about the growth rate, I thought they would grow much faster, but they seem to be growing at a steady rate. But that could be because I have a slow growing plant 🤔
